release_notes: First-time users see the welcome screen once; later launches open sign-in or the signed-in home directly after splash.
Explore opens sign-in immediately without waiting for the update check.
Forgot password now verifies an email OTP, then lets you enter and repeat a new password.
Password reset revokes existing sessions so the new password is required on other devices.
Refer & Earn can invite a selected contact after read-only Contacts permission is granted.
Stock images use Android's system picker, which shares only the photo you select.
